content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Billings

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you hold a secondary degree and can document the required project management education hours. No prior work experience is necessary—CAPM welcomes career changers and early-stage professionals entering Billings' growing project-based industries.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive format compresses the curriculum into focused sessions, letting you earn your required education without lengthy evening classes or extended commutes.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with the Project Management Institute and complete the credential application. Our team guides you through each requirement and helps you submit your documentation and exam fee directly to PMI.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions and study strategies tailored to the CAPM body of knowledge. Schedule your proctored exam when you feel confident and ready.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units during your three-year renewal cycle by attending courses, conferences, or contributing to project management activities. Renew your credential before expiration to stay current in Billings' competitive market.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.

While CAPM certification is not always mandatory for entry-level roles, it strengthens your competitive position, supports higher starting offers, and accelerates promotion timelines in these high-demand sectors where infrastructure and facility expansion projects are ongoing.

Credential demand remains steady across these sectors due to ongoing capital projects and operational expansion.
